title: The Bus Seat by the Window
youtube_title: The Bus Seat by the Window | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Veda is just outside the fun, close to a bus seat you could offer without making a show. Nils changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Veda has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
